title: Provider timesheet and maintenance runtime result validation

batches.validation: Actual boolean source provider result; rejected before PostgreSQL
Positive int4 revision and finite date-time; absent row uses revision 0 and null date
Known IDs, bounded strings and canonical placeholders; explicit four-field projection
Two existing action enums, finite timestamps, explicit action/date projection, maximum 20 rows
Zero/one configuration row, valid stored sender and projected templates before recovery/test delivery

sharedRateFix: Calculate returned retry seconds with clock_timestamp after row-lock waits. Transaction-start NOW can produce a spurious window+1 retry under concurrency. The strict bounds remain unchanged.
failureBehavior: Sanitized no-store; invalid configuration reads roll back; invalid mail configuration sends nothing and writes no acceptance audit
